fact: The Medium-Term Fiscal Scenario 2026-28, approved by the Council of Ministers on 24 June 2025, plans to introduce AI in tax control and forensic tax analysis by 2028 (planned, not in service).
title: Governo Quer Acabar Com Isenções Fiscais Ineficientes e Atingir Tributação Plena do Informal Até 2028 Com Recurso à Digitalização e IA
